'''Jin-Rio Akabi''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] from [[Colstev]].

==Biography==
===Joining the Rebellion===
Jin-Rio Akabi was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Colstev]]. She was a student at the [[University of Zo-Ro]] before the [[Massacre of Zo-Ro|massacre]] there. She joined the [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]] as a [[Political Advisor]] to stop further such incidents. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] she was involved with [[Takeover at Whisper Base|operations]] at the captured [[Whisper Base]].

===Onderon infiltration===
Jin-Rio, [[Zal Artha]], [[Vendri DeRalm]], [[Cael Hanarist]], [[Tendaar Bel]], and [[Arkhan Brem'tu]] were assigned to infiltrate Whisper Base on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. Their mission was to isolate the base from any external communication, disable the shuttles and capture the base before [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sarev]] called for reinforcements. Once the group landed on Onderon, they avoided [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] patrols and crossed the dense jungle for a few hours before they finally arrived at Whisper Base. They entered through the garage and quickly sliced the communication line, which caused an enemy patrol to direct their attention towards the garage.

===Takeover at Whisper Base===
{{RPG|"[[Takeover at Whisper Base (adventure)|Takeover at Whisper Base]]"}}
The squad of [[rebels]] hid in different areas successfully and awaited the patrol's arrival. They eliminated the patrol of soldiers in a fast and efficient manner, without alerting the rest of the base.
